content.short: Axal is a high-yield savings app for cash, Bitcoin and gold, powered by on-chain yield.
content.description: Axal is a savings app that puts idle cash, Bitcoin and gold to work through on-chain yield, so users grow their money without juggling accounts or trading. It reports more than $1 billion in transactions through the app. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Axal.
content.meta: Axal is a high-yield savings app for cash, BTC and gold using on-chain yield, listed on Stable.
